name: Loop de Cay
description: Additive overdub loop with level decay

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — Pitch (span from Base Note); spectrum LED meter. In Pitch→MIDI it transposes the CV pitch, so centre = unchanged and an unpatched jack leaves the fader in charge
Alt (Shift+Fader) — Decay strength: bottom = immortal, top ≈ 4 wraps (violet→red)
Third (Btn+Fader; gate modes while muted) — Decay mode zones (IR→UV): Random Rose · Pitch Up Orange · Pitch Down Yellow · Vel+Root Lime · Pitch Root Cyan · Velocity Blue · Gate Violet

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Hold (gate modes) — Note on; release = off (long notes OK). Hold+Fader = scale-degree glissando toward the fader (like Chord Vamp)

sections.heading: Params / LEDs
items: Mode: Pitch→MIDI · Gate→MIDI · MIDI→MIDI · MIDI→CV · Fader→Both
Decay Mode: Random · Pitch Up · Pitch Down · Vel+Root (default) · Pitch Root · Velocity · Gate
MIDI CH / In / Out, Base Note, Span (semitones across fader)
Capture/playback hit: sharp button 80% dim (~2 PPQN) + Top white; layer meters on Top/Bottom/Button

channels.jackDescription: Depends on Mode (Pitch→MIDI / Gate→MIDI use CV In; MIDI→CV / Fader→Both use CV Out)
channels.faderDescription: Span around Base Note; quantized to global scale. Pitch→MIDI adds it to the CV pitch as a transpose
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: 0 = immortal; higher ≈ fewer wraps to silence
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Seven zones IR→UV (Btn+Fader; gate modes while muted)
channels.fnDescription: Hold for note in gate modes; Hold+Fader = glissando; Shift+Short = bars; Shift+Long = mute/erase
